Game Overview

Popcorn Race 3D is a runner game built around race against time as a daring corn kernel in Popcorn Race 3D. Navigate thrilling tracks, collect kernels, and transform them into delicious popcorn explosions with dynamic machines. Hone your reflexes and strategy in diverse levels where adaptability is your key to mastering the popcorn challenge.
